numbers.formula: v5 (2026-10-19 13:52, package BF2): N = (Base + L/levelLinDiv) x (1 + L/levelDiv) for L >= 1, Base - zeroPenalty at Level 0; Base = base + perRarity x Rarity + perWait x W + perWait2 x W^2 + perLumber x Lumber + perLumber2 x Lumber^2 + perRitual x Ritual points + perMap x the map where the card becomes obtainable (owner 15:25; canonical/card-obtain-maps.json). levelLinDiv 10 (owner 15:48: let's try L/10; L/5 before). perLevel is v3 (N = Base + perLevel x L), kept for comparisons

v6.formula: (Base + L/10) × (1 + L/30), Base + 0.2 × Map (the helper's Map term)
